title: Efficient-VLN: A Simple yet Strong Baseline for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
selection_reason: Efficient-VLN reuses the vision-language model KV cache and applies contiguous RoPE so inference processes only the newly observed frame, directly reducing repeated computation for real-time navigation.
